name: Red Lentil Soup with Bacon, Cabbage, Carrots, Celery & Garlic Toast
ingredients: 48 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Trim and small dice celery; transfer both to a medium bowl.
Peel and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with the veggies.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
While the pot heats up, small dice bacon.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring often, until bacon has released its fat and is starting to brown, about 3 minutes.
Meanwhile, place lentils in a colander, rinse, and set aside to drain.
Add veggies and spices to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies are softened, about 5 minutes.
While the veggies cook, using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; halve the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.

Add cabbage, lentils, and broth to the pot; stir to combine, cover, and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to medium-low and continue to simmer, stirring occasionally, until lentils are tender, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Slice buns in half and place, cut-side up, on a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with garlic and spices.
Place buns in the oven and toast until golden, 1-2 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside.
Divide soup between bowls and serve with toasted buns on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
